messages.author: dcf3bc62f2c7ef06
messages.subject: axis position manipulation
parts: hello every body, i recently encounter a tiny problem of controlling the position of y axis, the default choice is that y axis is placed in the left, is there any solution that i can set my y axis in the right of the graph . i knew a deprecated function guide_axis might help to solve this issue , however this function is remove from the newest version of ggplot2 package. so is they any alternative left to control the position of axis in ggplot2?(not the dual axis that rejected by Hadley ) i'd appreciate it  very much if you guys could help with a convenient solution, best wishes~

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: axis position manipulation
parts:
See the following post on StackOverflow:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/15334494/how-to-change-positions-of-x-and-y-axis-in-ggplot2

See both the ggplot2 solution and the lattice solution given at the
bottom. Despite the post title, the problem has to do with moving the
y-axis to the right of the display.

Dennis
